start: ^I designed the core movement mechanics to feel incredibly fun, floaty, and slidy, drawing heavy inspiration from games like Splatoon and Ultrakill.
^Want to hear how I scoped the movement system?
technical_detail: ^I initially designed a high-mobility kit, including a red grappling hook, blue color-skating, and yellow satchel boosting.

^So to ensure that we deliver a polished product on time, I scoped down those ideas, focusing instead on perfecting the weight, slide friction, and responsiveness of our core movement physics so the fundamental navigation felt great to play.
